morphology.compounding_rule: [surname] + [given]; toponyms = quality/feature + type: Jin-cheng (golden-city), Bei-guan (north-pass), Da-jiang (great-river).
morphology.patronymic_form: the clan-surname (xing) comes first, then the given name (ming); generation-names within a zu (lineage); no patronymic particle.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen warlord cheng and tomb-mounds: 'the Tomb of [name]', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]'
patterns.military_units: the [general] Ying (camp/army) / the [color] Banner: 'the Tiger Ying', 'the Azure Banner'
patterns.ships: river-junk and war-junk names: 'the Red Cliff', 'Jade Dragon', 'the Heaven-Mandate'

religion._note: Deity-names are the Sinitic morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.sinitic) - never real Chinese gods. A Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven: the One (Aiteng) presides as Highest Heaven; the Lawful powers are the celestial officials (-di emperors, -jun lords); the Neutral honor ancestors (the zu) and the local earth-and-grain powers; the Chaotic defy the celestial order. Confucian rites and ancestor-veneration order all.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the opposing powers are the demon-marshals (mo) outside the celestial order, each with an epithet: Maraxus -> Maluo the War-Fire Marshal; Vacidus -> Wuci the Devourer; Lusanto -> Lusan the Coin-Serpent.

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaidun-di: a green mountain over the grain-altar
holy_symbol_motifs.Tuli-di: a red sun-disc above the scales and seal of office

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Miao (temple) of [power]: 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: deified heroes and worthy officials enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao; 'the Lord [name]'.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaidun-di (the Earth Emperor, lord of mountains)
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numeng-jun (the Sage Lord of the winds)

religion.the_one: Aiteng (< Aeternus; the Highest Heaven, the source of the Mandate, served not petitioned)

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the demon-marshals (mo) outside the celestial order - and names the Lawful celestial officials, and Aiteng, as the tyrant-court of Heaven to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful celestial officials under the Mandate - Aiteng the Highest Heaven, Tuli-di the Sun-Justice Emperor, Gaidun-di the Earth Emperor, Numeng-jun the Sage Lord - and names the Chaotic powers the demon-marshals (mo), warded; the celestial bureaucracy and the rites of the Mandate order all.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: honors the ancestors (the zu) and the local earth-and-grain powers, the celestial court invoked at the Miao situationally; Confucian rites and ancestor-veneration bind.

titles._tiers_note: Sinitic feudal, ascending; DISPLAY titles English, native Sinitic court titles beneath. The Huangdi (emperor) holds the Mandate of Heaven (Tianming) over the Diguo; the Wang are kings/princes; the peerage descends Gong (duke) > Hou (marquis) > Bo (count) > Nan (baron). The Dudu hold the frontier military commands (march). (Native rank titles are the real Chinese register, allowed; no Chinese term is on the approved-foreign list, so display rulers are English.)
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH. No Chinese rank-title is on the approved-foreign list, so no native term is promoted to display. The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Celestial-Mandate realm: the Huangdi over the wang and the five peerages, the Confucian bureaucracy of officials; the celestial court and mandarinate)
titles.heir: Taizi (crown prince); Shizi (heir of a wang or noble)
